items.title: Register Antigravity as a first-class host runtime
items.context: Current host runtime validation and probe code only accepts fake, claude-code, gemini, and codex. Add antigravity with command agy and keep any Gemini handling explicitly legacy/deprecated.

happy.desc: host_runtime_probe accepts antigravity and agy, normalizes both to host antigravity, and reports cliCommand agy.

edge.desc: When agy is missing from PATH, the probe reports unavailable or missing-cli with an actionable nextAction and does not fall back to another current host.

adversarial.desc: Gemini is treated only as deprecated legacy compatibility, not as a current runtime advertised or preferred by Antigravity registration paths.

items.userSees: `host_runtime_probe --host=antigravity --json` returns a JSON object with host="antigravity", cliCommand="agy", and an availability status derived from the local agy binary; legacy `--host=gemini` remains explicitly deprecated/legacy.

verificationEvidence.command: node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_probe --host=antigravity --json && node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_probe --host=agy --json
verificationEvidence.note: Both probes passed: antigravity returns host=antigravity and cliCommand=agy; agy returns host=antigravity, requestedHost=agy, matchedFallback=true, cliCommand=agy.
Restricted PATH hides agy and the probe reports status=unavailable, runtimeKind=missing-cli, cliCommand=agy, and nextAction=Install or expose agy in PATH without falling back to another current host.

verificationEvidence.command: node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_probe --host=gemini --json && node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_list --json
verificationEvidence.note: Gemini probe remains accepted only as legacy compatibility with explicit deprecated/legacy warning and limitation text; host_runtime_list advertises fake,codex,claude-code,antigravity and omits gemini from the current runtime list.

items.title: Update dispatch policy and runtime surfaces for the current three-host set
items.context: Host runtime list/probe/status and policy allow-lists must recognize Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI. Error messages and docs should stop presenting Gemini as a current host.

happy.desc: host list, docs, and policy surfaces show the current three real hosts as codex, claude-code, and antigravity, with agy as the Antigravity CLI command.

edge.desc: Dispatch policy creation and checks accept antigravity as an allowed host and persist or report the normalized current host value.

adversarial.desc: User-facing errors, help, and policy messages do not advertise Gemini as a current host; any Gemini mention is explicitly legacy or deprecated.

items.userSees: `host_runtime_list --json` and host/dispatch policy surfaces present Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI as the current real host set, with Gemini wording limited to legacy/deprecated compatibility.

verificationEvidence.note: Runtime list returns fake,codex,claude-code,antigravity; current real hosts are codex, claude-code, antigravity, and antigravity reports cliCommand=agy. README, docs/guide.md, and host-overflow.md were updated to match.

verificationEvidence.command: node --input-type=module -e "import { checkDispatchPolicy } from ./packages/main/dist/core/dispatch-policy.js; /* antigravity and agy smoke */"
verificationEvidence.note: No-write policy smoke passed: allowedHosts=[antigravity] authorizes with normalizedPolicy.allowedHosts=[antigravity], and allowedHosts=[agy] also authorizes while normalizing to antigravity.

Expected refusal names current hosts as fake|codex|claude-code|antigravity and says agy aliases to antigravity; gemini is accepted only for legacy compatibility, so errors do not advertise Gemini as current.

items.title: Verify agy host detection and legacy Gemini behavior
items.context: Add focused smoke coverage or command verification proving host_runtime_probe accepts antigravity/agy and reports the agy command, while Gemini remains legacy rather than the advertised current host.

happy.desc: Build or focused smoke verification passes and proves antigravity and agy probes resolve to host antigravity with cliCommand agy.

edge.desc: Legacy Gemini probe behavior remains bounded and explicitly legacy or deprecated, without becoming part of the default current host set.

adversarial.desc: Verification does not require or use a direct Gemini CLI invocation; Gemini is not needed as a current runtime for the Antigravity smoke path.

items.userSees: Verification output shows build/smoke checks passing for Antigravity/agy host detection and shows legacy Gemini behavior remains bounded and non-current; no direct Gemini CLI execution is required.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_probe --host=antigravity --json && node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_probe --host=agy --json
verificationEvidence.note: Build passed. Focused probes show antigravity and agy both resolve to host=antigravity with cliCommand=agy; agy sets matchedFallback=true.

verificationEvidence.command: node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_probe --host=gemini --json && node bin/lattice.js host_runtime_list --json
verificationEvidence.note: Legacy Gemini probe remains bounded and explicit: warnings/limitations say deprecated legacy compatibility and current third-host flows use antigravity/agy. host_runtime_list omits gemini from the default current runtime set.

Gemini verification did not require invoking the Gemini CLI for version/help or execution; the probe only performs safe command-path detection and states version/help probing is intentionally skipped. Antigravity/agy smoke paths do not depend on Gemini.
